card_set: BOOSTER PACK The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You [UE21BT]
card_text:
【Nullify Impact】 (The character battling this character loses Impact for the duration of this battle.)
If this character has 5000 or more BP, it gains 【Impact (1)】 (When this character attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to your opponent.)
[When Sidelined] You may place one card from your hand into your sideline. If you do, add up to one card with 3 or less required energy from your sideline to your hand.
